description: Configuration for college football awards and media mock draft rankings

heisman.description: Heisman Trophy - Most Outstanding Player in College Football

position_bias.note: QBs historically favored in Heisman voting

team_success_bonus.note: Bonus points added to team success score

all_american.description: All-American Teams - Best players at each position

conference_awards.description: Conference-level awards (Offensive/Defensive Player of the Year)

mock_draft.description: Media mock draft rankings with source-specific biases
mock_draft.note: Gaussian noise with sigma=15 means ~68% of rankings within ±15 spots

hype_susceptibility_by_source.note: How much each source is influenced by media hype (0.0-1.0)

pff.description: Analytics-focused, low hype susceptibility, grades over narrative
pff.note: PFF relies on film grades and analytics, resistant to hype

hype_vs_talent.note: Gap thresholds for classification and max adjustment to draft evaluation (±15%)
